in_sanskrit.name: रोहिणीप्रिय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is dear to Rohini, the wife of moon god Chandra.

in_marathi.name: Rohinipriya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Beloved of Rohini
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rohinipriya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit words 'Rohini' and 'priya', meaning 'beloved' and 'of Rohini' respectively. Rohini is a name of the moon and also a star in the Taurus constellation.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Beloved of Rohini
